notes: Every response body below is the exact bytes the production controller served through the production encoder; none was written by hand.

The Webadmin envelope carries the legacy V1 compatibility trio (message/status/can_send) and escapes unicode and slashes, because it is built by Webadmin::noStoreReply to stay byte-identical with the legacy webadminapi. The three receipted actions are no-store.
ONE revision guards the whole moderation plane. Every decide and every settings write moves it; a stale one answers 409 with data.current to adopt.
A request id retried with IDENTICAL material replays (replayed: true). The same id with different material is a conflict, not a replay.

member_creation_enabled defaults to FALSE and must stay false through the member-import cutover window: any write to profile_tag_items between an import dry run and its apply refuses that apply with member-import-protected-target-changed.
A moderation reason is never served to a member. No member body here contains moderation_reason, moderated_by, created_by_uid or label_fold.

request_fields.admin_email: the operator identity, as every webadmin action sends it
